laboratory_assumption: 100% of sensory modalities (DNS, TLS, DOM, Visual) are always accessible
operational_reality: Missing Not At Random (MNAR): 86.7% of phishing URLs fail HTML acquisition (dead/taken down)
observed_impact: Complete-case evaluations artificially deflate phishing prevalence from 50.0% to 16.2%
mitigation_in_phishpe: Progressive Fallback to M0 (Strategy C) on socket timeouts / DNS drops

laboratory_assumption: Missing features can be imputed with default zeros without retraining
operational_reality: Supervised models learn missing flags as anomaly indicators; causes FP explosion
observed_impact: Naive zero-imputation in M2 inflates FPR from 3.38% to 18.67% (56 benign sites blocked)
mitigation_in_phishpe: Strict prohibition of punitive zero-imputation; fallback to lower verified tiers
verification_status: Audited in Phase 3 (Strategy F vs Strategy C)

laboratory_assumption: Latency is dominated by deep ML model feature processing and inference
operational_reality: CPU computation is < 15ms; Internet socket roundtrips dominate in 98.8% of time
observed_impact: M1 network I/O takes 1,272ms P50; Chrome CDP takes 2,166ms P50
mitigation_in_phishpe: Early exit on lexical M0 resolves 39% of clear traffic locally (< 6ms P50)

laboratory_assumption: Phishing URLs always exhibit high lexical entropy and anomalous characters
operational_reality: Sophisticated phishing leverages clean subdomains on Google/Firebase/GitHub
observed_impact: Symmetric cascade exits early as benign in M0, yielding 6 avoidable false negatives
mitigation_in_phishpe: Asymmetric Guard: Requires p0 <= 0.005 for benign exit; forces M1 infrastructure check
verification_status: Audited in Phase 2 & 5 (Policy C recovers 6 attacks)

laboratory_assumption: Selective classification can abstain whenever uncertainty exists
operational_reality: A 3.62% abstention rate generates 36,200 daily tickets in 1M request gateways
observed_impact: Overwhelms human forensic capacity unless reserved for high-risk accounts
mitigation_in_phishpe: Configurable dual-mode: Autonomous Fallback (Policy C) vs Human SOC (Policy D)
verification_status: Audited in Phase 2 & 5 (Policies C and D compared)

operational_reality: Blocking navigation degrades user browsing flow; Nielsen rule requires < 100ms
